PRELIM.gloss: a minor match preceding the main event
PRELIM.definition: A minor match preceding the main event.

PERIL.definition: A source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune.
PERIL.example: Drinking alcohol is a health hazard.

MILER.gloss: the length of something in miles
MILER.definition: (used only in combinations) the length of something in miles.

IMPEL.gloss: urge or force to an action
IMPEL.definition: Urge or force (a person) to an action; constrain or motivate.

MILE.gloss: a unit of length equal to 1,760 yards or 5,280 feet
MILE.definition: A unit of length equal to 1,760 yards or 5,280 feet; exactly 1609.344 meters.

PILE.gloss: a collection of objects laid on top of each other
PILE.definition: A collection of objects laid on top of each other.

LIE.definition: Be located or situated somewhere; occupy a certain position.

RIP.example: The curtain ripped from top to bottom.

PIE.gloss: dish baked in pastry-lined pan often with a pastry top
PIE.definition: Dish baked in pastry-lined pan often with a pastry top.

LIP.gloss: either of two fleshy folds of tissue that surround the mouth and play a role in speaking
LIP.definition: Either of two fleshy folds of tissue that surround the mouth and play a role in speaking.

LIME.gloss: a caustic substance produced by heating limestone
LIME.definition: A caustic substance produced by heating limestone.

RIM.gloss: the shape of a raised edge of a more or less circular object
RIM.definition: The shape of a raised edge of a more or less circular object.

PIER.gloss: a platform built out from the shore into the water and supported by piles
PIER.definition: A platform built out from the shore into the water and supported by piles; provides access to ships and boats.

RIPE.gloss: fully developed or matured and ready to be eaten or used
RIPE.definition: Fully developed or matured and ready to be eaten or used.

LIMP.gloss: walk impeded by some physical limitation or injury
LIMP.definition: Walk impeded by some physical limitation or injury.
LIMP.example: The old woman hobbles down to the store every day.
